subject: Re: MERF kickoff — compute + staffing
body:
Zofia,

As requested, the resourcing picture:

Staffing — Yara 50% (TL, training + quality), Milan 40% on the baking pipeline and viewer, Leilani 30% on the serving/embedding side via Shipyard. Lean but sufficient for three milestones.

Compute — May reproduction runs fit titan-a100 best-effort (16 GPUs per scene, 9 mipnerf360 scenes, staggered). The crunch is June: the full baking-validation sweep needs concentrated capacity, so we hold the vulcan-h100 reservation — 128 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-15 — to retrain + bake all scenes at final settings in one pass ahead of the 06-19 milestone. Reservation is confirmed in the sheet.

Storage is trivial by our standards (baked scenes are the whole point — tens of MB each).

One flag: browser viewer perf testing needs real consumer GPUs, not datacenter cards; Leilani is procuring two test rigs.

Jelena
